title: Hayati Coffee Nicotine Pouches
description: Hayati Coffee nicotine pouches delivers a Coffee flavour with gentle roasted notes for a rich, robust yet soothing taste. Each slim pouch sits neatly under the lip and releases nicotine gradually without smoke, vapour or noticeable odour. Available in 12mg (Strong), 20mg (X Strong) and 30mg (X Strong). Each can includes 20 pouches in a compact, pocket-friendly format. Created by Hayati, a UK brand specialising in vape and nicotine products, this pouch collection focuses on familiar flavours and straightforward strength choices. Explore more Hayati Nicotine Pouch flavours such as Cola, Blueberry and Rubyberry. Nicotine Ranges: Strong - 12mg this is suited for more experienced users Extra Strong - 20mg to 30mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Nicotine Pouches Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
